svg.title: Parent app concept
svg.desc: Three illustrated phone screens for parents: a list of each child's chats with a weekly summary, a wellbeing view with mood signals and topics, and an instant safety alert with the conversation and helplines.
svg.text: Same app, behind a parent PIN or Face ID. Concept screens, not screenshots.

g.text: Sara asked about space, sharks and food.
Settings: age 11 · buddy Rivet · topics to avoid
We gave her kind words and helplines
That sounds hard. You're not alone.
A grown-up you trust can help, and
Alerts come by push and email.
